chakras.name: Root
chakras.context: Traditionally associated with foundations, belonging and steadiness.
chakras.practice: Notice the points of contact between your feet and the floor. Let your breathing remain natural.

chakras.name: Sacral
chakras.context: Often associated with creativity, emotional experience and the capacity for enjoyment.
chakras.practice: Notice a sensation or emotion without needing to label it good or bad.

chakras.name: Solar Plexus
chakras.context: Traditionally linked to purposeful action, confidence and personal agency.
chakras.practice: Name one small decision you can make with intention today.

chakras.name: Heart
chakras.context: Often associated with compassion, connection and care, including healthy boundaries.
chakras.practice: Pause and offer yourself one kind, realistic sentence.

chakras.name: Throat
chakras.context: Associated in many modern chakra teachings with communication and expression.
chakras.practice: Notice what you want to say, then choose a clear and kind way to say it.

chakras.name: Third Eye
chakras.context: Often used as a symbol of insight, discernment and inward attention.
chakras.practice: Notice one thought, then ask whether it is a fact or an interpretation.

chakras.name: Crown
chakras.context: Associated with spiritual meaning and connection in some traditions.
chakras.practice: Sit quietly for a moment and consider what gives your actions meaning.
